capabilities: Edit marimo notebook cells with Obsidian-native UI
Run reactive cells through a local marimo Python runtime
Render interactive widgets, Markdown previews and Plotly/Vega charts
Inspect variables and cell dependencies in side panels
Generate or refactor cells via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
extras: Desktop only. Connecting to the runtime executes notebook Python unsandboxed with user permissions; the AI key is saved in plaintext in the plugin's data.json. Requires exactly marimo 0.25.2; other versions are rejected. Windows and Linux GUI behavior is unverified.
intentEvidence: The main notebook view does not embed a website or webview.
problem: Obsidian has no way to edit or execute marimo notebooks, so users must switch to the official browser editor to work with .py notebook files.

relations.evidence: connect to the real local marimo runtime
use inline completion through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint you configure

requires.name: Python 3.12 with marimo 0.25.2 in a virtual environment

summary: Native editor for reactive marimo Python notebooks that runs cells through a local marimo runtime inside Obsidian.
